rationale.intuition: UMich anchor ~15.6% overall but OOS rate ~12%. 强 profile + EA + 强 EC (DECA state champion, tennis captain) 在 12% baseline 上 lift 到 15-30% 范围是合理 reach。原版期望 25-55% match 是**乐观了** — OOS applicant 在 UMich 没有 in-state preference，counselor 的 geoMultiplier 正确反映这一点。Fixture 2026-05-24 调整后期望反映 OOS reality。

sources.name: UMich CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 15.64%; OOS rate ~12%; in-state rate ~25% (Section C)

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024
sources.evidence: EA at flagship publics gives 1.1-1.3× lift over RD; OOS applicants face additional state-preference penalty

sources.name: Calibration adjustment log 2026-05-24
sources.evidence: Original spec assumed in-state strong; engine produced 12% which is mathematically consistent with UMich OOS published rate. Range widened down to admit OOS reality while keeping upper bound aspirational for ideal candidates
